primer: Sai Life Sciences (NSE: SAILIFE) is an integrated, 100% regulated-market innovator CRDMO. It pairs US and UK discovery labs in Boston and Manchester with ~920 KL of Indian plants in Hyderabad, Bollaram, and Bidar. The firm earns COMPOUNDER_PASS (PASS_WITH_WATCH) on its 28–29% OPM jump and 34 commercial NCEs, yet the stock at ₹1,928.80 (109.72x TTM P/E, 79.3 RSI, +22.9% above 50D SMA) is stretched. With 0 shares held, we rate it WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (₹1,420–₹1,540 entry zone, ₹1,290 stop, ₹2,050 base target; 2.04:1 R:R) and keep 100% of marginal cash.
